tokens.v: Framed 1:1 life-size on the home row, the board filling the frame corner to corner: camera at case level twenty centimetres out, lens axis level with the tops of the caps and tilted down 12 degrees, 100mm at f/4. The caps are genuinely low-profile — short flat PBT slabs barely four millimetres proud with a shallow dish, never tall sculpted blocks — the near off-white alpha row running out of both side edges, the case's low front lip one razor line beneath them, the knurled knob soft at top-right with one bright notch on its rim. Only two fingertips enter the picture: the index and middle of a right hand crossing the right frame edge, cropped at the middle knuckle so no palm, wrist, arm, cuff or any other part of a body is anywhere in frame, the index resting on one alpha cap sitting visibly a millimetre below its neighbours, its backlight halo the brightest thing here and bleeding a thin even line under every blank cap. Focus pinned on that pressed cap, the rear function row soft. One warm practical low at camera-right skims the anodised flank into a long streak. Case unmarked.
